item.description: 🎓 Research Papers Into Videos A new GLM-5.4 skill turns arXiv papers into two-minute educational videos in the style of 3Blue1Brown, known for visual explanations of neural networks and mathematics. AlphaXiv has also added short videos to research papers in its trends section. ✔️ Upload any document, including raw PDF files ✔️ Get a narrated video with detailed animations ✔️ The model highlights key ideas and suggests visual explanations 👉 Link 👈 Try it with a paper you want to understand faster, then compare the generated explanation with the original research. 💻 @program

item.description: ⚠️ Claude KYC Evasion Warning A circulating guide describes ways to bypass Claude’s KYC checks using fake Indian passports, AI-generated images, or help from people in other countries. It also includes a forum template for seeking outside assistance with identity verification. These methods involve misrepresenting identity or location and may breach Anthropic’s rules. ✔️ Fake identity documents are used to imitate another country ✔️ AI tools are suggested for editing verification photos ✔️ Third parties are asked to complete KYC assistance ✔️ The guide says country details must match across the form 👉 Link 👈 Do not submit false documents or use someone else’s identity. Use official access and support channels instead. 💻 @program
